subject: Next: 30-min product preview — two candidate timebands + ops liaison

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Next: 30-min product preview — two candidate timebands + ops liaison

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Novaforge is evaluating inference options for your recommendations pipeline with goals to cut per-request latency by ~30% and reduce hosting cost for peak batch runs. Key constraints you highlighted were VPC-only deployment and an SSO requirement for audit logs.

Next step: we suggest a focused 30-minute product preview to demonstrate the runtime, routing policies, and how our autoscaling would look for Novaforge. To keep this tight and useful for your stakeholders, can you do two things:

- Pick 2 candidate timebands (preferably within the next 7 business days) that work for the group — we’ll hold the top choice and release the backup if it doesn’t confirm within 24 hours.
- Nominate the ops liaison who will own infra questions during the session (we saw you mentioned Amit in the call — cc him if that’s correct).

Candidate windows from our side (Pacific time):
- Wed Apr 12 — 10:00–10:30am PT
- Thu Apr 13 — 2:30–3:00pm PT
- Fri Apr 14 — 9:00–9:30am PT (short notice)

I attached a mutual action plan stub so we can record owners/next steps quickly. If you’d prefer a technical deep dive instead of the high-level preview, say the word and we’ll bring a runtime engineer and extend to 45 minutes.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
